note: H233: opencheck v3 -- CITED_VERIFIED / CITATION_BROKEN, and the split of NO_OPENING into nowhere vs elsewhere-and-unsaid.

controls.name: C1_selfcheck_covers_both_sides_of_the_declaration
controls.must_fire_because: a pointer a checker cannot refuse is a field that turns a red row green by being typed
controls.can_fail_because: any of the 13 arms fails, including the four constructed ways a pointer can lie
controls.null_must_contain: the arm list and the exit code

arms: ok    A1 a dropped object is FLAGGED
ok    A2 the same digest with its object is NOT flagged
ok    A3 an artifact with no digest produces no rows
ok    A4 a file digest is out of population
ok    A5 a one-entry perturbation does NOT open the digest
ok    A7 a mutated digest recorded under controls/ is NOT reported
ok    A8 publish() output opens, and it refuses to re-hash itself
ok    A9 a resolving opens_at is CITED_VERIFIED, not NO_OPENING
ok    A10 all four ways a pointer can lie are CITATION_BROKEN
ok    A11 a keyed opens_at verifies one digest and does not cover the other
ok    A6 a directory holding a repo root is pruned
ok    F4a G101 opens from its own artifacts
ok    F4b G59 does NOT open from its own artifacts

controls.name: C2_the_two_repaired_sites_verify
controls.must_fire_because: the repair must be checked by the same instrument that reported the defect, on the live artifacts
controls.can_fail_because: G95 or G96 stops resolving to G88's object

controls.name: C3_split_is_exhaustive
controls.must_fire_because: every NO_OPENING must land in exactly one bucket or the split is hiding a third case

falsifiers.name: F1_the_collapse_is_not_real
falsifiers.can_fail_because: fewer than 3 sites resolve to an object published elsewhere
falsifiers.null_must_contain: the elsewhere count and the threshold
falsifiers.refutes: that NO_OPENING was carrying two different things
falsifiers.fires_when: fewer than 3 sites resolve to an object published elsewhere
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F4_the_count_did_not_move
falsifiers.can_fail_because: NO_OPENING is still 22 after v3 and the two re-runs
falsifiers.refutes: that the vocabulary change bought anything measurable
falsifiers.fires_when: NO_OPENING is still 22 after v3 and the two re-runs
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire
